premises.text: Parents of school-going children face a bundled set of pains: school communication, child safety/health, progress reports, in-person fee payment, and daily student needs
premises.evidence_span: we have shortlisted five major pain points that a parent faces with regard to their school-going children

premises.text: Two-way notification messaging connects parents and teachers
premises.evidence_span: Two-way communication between parents and teachers

premises.text: Instant report cards deliver progress to parents immediately

premises.evidence_span: Third is GPS tracking. It's about the tracking system. So it's about security of the child

premises.text: Online payment gateway lets parents pay school fees without going to school
premises.evidence_span: Fourth is payment gateway. So instantly, if you see payments, I would say you just go on. You don't have to go to school now. You just do the payments online from our app

premises.text: In-app e-commerce delivers uniforms and stationery to the home
premises.evidence_span: fifth is e-commerce solution for all the daily needs of the child, which is like buying a uniform. To any stationery, it can be done online. And it will be delivered to your home

premises.text: Go-to-market targets private mid- to upper-high-end Indian schools (~30,000) with an enrollment goal
premises.evidence_span: we are targeting a market of the private mid-high and upper high-end schools, which are 30,000 in number

domains.name: Five major parent school pain points

value.text: Solve parents' school-related communication, safety, reporting, payment, and supply needs in one app
value.evidence_span: how are we actually solving the problem by giving you a live demo of the app

causal_links.evidence_span: find a need and solve the problem
School Bridge has a tremendous potential in this growing Indian education market

notes: Canonical School Bridge shape (v1.5.1 §4.1.6): one pain-bundle premise for the five parent pains; five capability premises for messaging, reports, GPS, payments, e-commerce; plus GTM targeting. Equity ask excluded.
